scope: Two source-boundary failures from the Phase3 fixture smoke, reproduced once each with unchanged intended assertions.

cases.original_smoke_input: 2077 (incidental; the failing boundary call is constant)

Alchemist also uses debt amounts as divQ128 operands at lines666,1604,1807; these callers need an explicit numerator<2^128 bound before production unreachability can be asserted. This is an internal library exposed through a production-code harness, not an externally deployed entry point.

cases.observed: addStake reverted with empty revert data; the intended success assertion failed with Panic(0x01).
